questions.question: Describe how food services onboard improve the overall travel experience.
questions.solution_html:
•  Provides comfort and satisfaction during long journeys.
  •  Enhances the airline’s image and passenger loyalty.
  •  Offers refreshment and relaxation, reducing travel fatigue.
  •  Reflects hospitality and attention to customer care.
  •  Helps passengers manage meal timings across time zones.
  •  Creates a positive impression through taste, variety, and presentation.
questions.final_answer:  Creates a positive impression through taste, variety, and presentation
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe the importance of personal hygiene of food handlers in flight catering units.
questions.solution_html:
•  Prevents contamination of food with harmful microorganisms.
  •  Ensures passenger safety and prevents foodborne illnesses.
  •  Maintains cleanliness standards required by aviation authorities.
  •  Promotes professionalism and builds customer trust.
  •  Includes practices such as clean uniforms, handwashing, hair covering, and health checks.
  •  Ensures compliance with HACCP and airline hygiene regulations.
questions.final_answer:  Ensures compliance with HACCP and airline hygiene regulations
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain how passenger feedback is incorporated into onboard catering services.
questions.solution_html:
•  They collect feedback through surveys, comment cards, and digital platforms.
  •  Data is analyzed to identify popular dishes and areas for improvement.
  •  Menus are revised based on taste preferences and dietary needs.
  •  Feedback helps in improving service timing, portion sizes, and packaging.
  •  Enhances overall meal quality and customer satisfaction.
questions.final_answer:  Enhances overall meal quality and customer satisfaction
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Demonstrate as to how the airlines accommodate diabetic passengers?
questions.solution_html:
• Demonstrate as to how the airlines accommodate diabetic passengers
  •  Provide pre-booked special diabetic meals (low sugar, low fat, controlled carbohydrates).
  •  Use artificial sweeteners instead of sugar.
  •  Avoid fried or high-fat foods.
  •  Include whole grains, lean proteins, and fresh fruits/vegetables.
  •  Ensure meal timing matches the passenger’s medical needs.
  •  Proper labeling and handling to prevent mix-ups.
questions.final_answer:  Proper labeling and handling to prevent mix-ups
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: List two cultural benefits of offering regional dishes onboard.

  •  Showcases the airline’s respect for various cuisines and traditions.
  •  Enhances cultural exchange and appreciation during travel.
questions.final_answer:  Enhances cultural exchange and appreciation during travel
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Analyze how hygiene and cleaning routines are planned on a cruise ship.
questions.solution_html:
• Analyze how hygiene and cleaning routines are planned on a cruise ship
  •  Hygiene routines are scheduled daily and monitored by housekeeping and food safety teams.
  •  Cleaning plans follow international maritime health and sanitation standards.
  •  Different zones (kitchen, dining, cabins, decks) have specific cleaning schedules.
  •  Use of approved disinfectants and sanitizers for all food contact surfaces.
  •  Regular inspection of galleys, storage rooms, and waste disposal areas.
  •  Staff undergo hygiene training and follow handwashing and uniform protocols.
  •  Waste segregation and pest control systems ensure a clean environment.
  •  Records are maintained for audits and health authority inspections.
questions.final_answer:  Records are maintained for audits and health authority inspections
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss the safety, hygiene, and sanitation measures incorporated in pantry car design.
questions.solution_html:
•  Pantry cars are designed with stainless steel surfaces for easy cleaning and corrosion
  • resistance.
  •  Adequate ventilation and temperature control to prevent food spoilage.
  •  Separate areas for raw and cooked foods to avoid cross-contamination.
  •  Provision of handwashing stations and waste bins with covers.
  •  Fire safety systems, including extinguishers and alarms, installed for emergencies.
  •  Proper drainage and non-slip flooring to maintain sanitation.
  •  Regular cleaning schedules and pest control measures implemented.
  •  Compliance with Indian Railways and FSSAI hygiene standards.
questions.final_answer:  Compliance with Indian Railways and FSSAI hygiene standards
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss the definition and scope of onboard food service with suitable examples.
questions.solution_html:
•  Definition: Onboard food service refers to the preparation, handling, and serving of food and
  • beverages to passengers while traveling by air, sea, or rail.
  •  Scope
  • o Airlines: In-flight catering units provide pre-packed meals like continental
  • vegetarian, or special diets.
  • o Cruise ships: Offer elaborate multi-course meals, buffets, and specialty restaurants.
  • o Railways: Pantry cars or station-based catering for passengers during travel.
  • o Covers menu planning, storage, service methods, and passenger satisfaction.
  • o Involves hygiene, safety, and logistics management in restricted environments.
questions.final_answer: o Involves hygiene, safety, and logistics management in restricted environments
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain how special meal planning enhances the overall food service system onboard.
questions.solution_html:
•  Meets the dietary needs of passengers (e.g., diabetic, vegetarian, gluten-free).
  •  Increases passenger satisfaction and comfort during travel.
  •  Demonstrates the airline’s or cruise line’s attention to customer care.
  •  Reduces risks of allergic reactions or medical emergencies.
  •  Reflects cultural sensitivity and inclusiveness.
  •  Helps build brand image and repeat customer loyalty.
  •  Encourages efficient meal management and accurate pre-order systems.
questions.final_answer:  Encourages efficient meal management and accurate pre-order systems
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
